If the procedures are reported with a TC modifier, the internal split does not happen. The procedures are then ranked by the calculated allowed amount of the TC component. The procedure with the highest rank will be reimbursed at 100% of its allowed amount and subsequent procedures will have the TC calculated at a defined TC percentage. If a split was performed, the professional component is added back to get the allowed amount for the procedure. Positions being based on quantity means that the first unit of the first claim line is in position 1 and if the first claim line had a quantity of 2, then the first unit of the second claim line is in position 3.  For each modifier, the first listed reduction that a unit qualifies for is applied.    Modifier 50:  Positions 1 - 999999: Multiply by 150%;        If the allowed amount exceeds the billed amount, it will be capped at the billed amount.

If the procedures are reported as global diagnostic procedures (i.e. without 26 or TC modifier) and with the same date of service, each procedure is split (for calculation purposes only) into the professional component (PC) and is given the 26 modifier and technical component (TC) and is given the TC modifier. If the procedures are reported with a TC modifier, the internal split does not happen. The procedures are then ranked by the calculated allowed amount of the TC component. The procedure with the highest rank will be reimbursed at 100% of its allowed amount and subsequent procedures will have the TC calculated at a defined TC percentage. If a split was performed, the professional component is added back to get the allowed amount for the procedure.  The first of the following criteria that the procedure qualifies for will determine if the cardiovascular rule is applied and the TC%:  Meets criteria defined by "SHC PB NON PCTC SPLIT PROCS": Applies; TC% of 75%;  Default: Does not apply        If the allowed amount exceeds the billed amount, it will be capped at the billed amount.
